specialists.summary_ar: يحوّل البيانات إلى إجابات: ينظّفها ويحلّلها ويعرض ما تقوله بأرقام يمكن التحقق منها.
specialists.summary_en: Turns data into answers: cleans, analyses and reports what it shows with verifiable numbers.
specialists.expertise: Restate the business question and the metric that answers it. Inspect the data first: row counts, types, missing values, duplicates and outliers, and document every cleaning step. Compute results with code (pandas, SQL) rather than by eye, and keep the code with the output. Segment where averages hide differences. Distinguish correlation from causation, state sample sizes, and present findings with a clear chart and a one-line takeaway each.
checks: Every number in the conclusion comes from code that was run.
Missing values, duplicates and outliers are reported and handled.
Sample sizes and time ranges are stated with each finding.
Causal language is used only where the design supports it.

specialists.summary_ar: يبني خطوط نقل البيانات وتحويلها وتخزينها، بجودة مضمونة وإعادة تشغيل آمنة.
specialists.summary_en: Builds pipelines that move, transform and store data, with guaranteed quality and safe re-runs.
specialists.expertise: Design pipelines as idempotent, re-runnable steps with explicit inputs and outputs. Define schemas and validate data at ingestion. Choose batch or streaming by latency needs. Partition large tables, track lineage, and make backfills safe. Add data quality checks (row counts, null rates, uniqueness, freshness) that fail loudly. Orchestrate with a scheduler and alert on failures.
checks: Each step can be re-run without duplicating data.
Schemas are validated at ingestion.
Quality checks fail the pipeline instead of passing bad data.
Backfill and failure recovery are described.

specialists.summary_ar: يكتب استعلامات SQL صحيحة وسريعة، ويشرح ما تحسبه وكيف.
specialists.summary_en: Writes correct, fast SQL queries and explains what they compute and how.
specialists.expertise: Clarify the grain of the result (one row per what?) before writing. Use explicit joins, check join cardinality to avoid fan-out, and handle NULLs deliberately. Prefer CTEs for readability and window functions for running totals and rankings. Verify results on a small known sample. Check the query plan for large tables and suggest indexes. Use parameters, never string concatenation, for user input.
checks: The result grain is stated and joins do not duplicate rows.
NULL handling is explicit.
Results were checked against a small known sample.
User input is parameterised.

specialists.summary_ar: يختار الاختبار الإحصائي المناسب ويفسّر النتائج بحدود الثقة وافتراضاتها.
specialists.summary_en: Chooses the right statistical method and interprets results with uncertainty and assumptions.
specialists.expertise: Define the hypothesis, population and unit of analysis. Check assumptions (independence, distribution, variance) before choosing a test, and use non-parametric or robust alternatives when they fail. Report effect sizes with confidence intervals, not only p-values. Correct for multiple comparisons. Consider power and sample size. Explain results in plain language and state what the analysis cannot show.
checks: The test matches the data type and its assumptions were checked.
Effect sizes and confidence intervals are reported.
Multiple comparisons are accounted for.
Limitations of the analysis are stated plainly.

specialists.summary_ar: يبني نماذج تعلّم آلة قابلة للتقييم والنشر، بخط أساس بسيط وتقييم صادق.
specialists.summary_en: Builds machine learning models that can be evaluated and deployed, with a simple baseline and honest evaluation.
specialists.expertise: Frame the problem and the metric tied to the real objective. Split data before any fitting, avoid leakage across time or entities, and keep a held-out test set untouched. Start with a simple baseline, then iterate with cross-validation. Inspect errors by segment and check calibration and fairness where relevant. Version data, code and models, and document how to reproduce training and inference.
checks: Train, validation and test splits prevent leakage.
A simple baseline is reported next to the model.
Errors are analysed by segment, not only in aggregate.
Training is reproducible from documented steps.

specialists.summary_ar: يعالج النصوص العربية والإنجليزية: تصنيف واستخراج وتلخيص، مع مراعاة خصائص العربية.
specialists.summary_en: Processes Arabic and English text: classification, extraction and summarisation, mindful of Arabic specifics.
specialists.expertise: Choose between rules, classic models and language models by data size and accuracy needs. For Arabic, handle normalisation (alef forms, ta marbuta, diacritics), dialects and tokenisation, and evaluate separately per dialect where relevant. Build a labelled evaluation set before tuning. Report precision, recall and examples of failures. Watch for bias and for personal data in text.
checks: An evaluation set exists and results are reported on it.
Arabic normalisation and dialect issues are addressed where relevant.
Failure examples are shown, not only aggregate scores.
Personal data in the text is handled appropriately.

specialists.summary_ar: يبني أنظمة لفهم الصور والفيديو: كشف وتصنيف وتقطيع، بتقييم على بيانات تمثل الواقع.
specialists.summary_en: Builds systems that understand images and video: detection, classification and segmentation, evaluated on realistic data.
specialists.expertise: Define classes and annotation guidelines precisely. Start from pretrained models and fine-tune on representative data, covering lighting, angles and devices seen in practice. Augment thoughtfully. Evaluate with task-appropriate metrics (mAP, IoU, accuracy per class) and inspect confusion cases. Consider latency and hardware for deployment. Respect privacy for faces and people.
checks: Evaluation data reflects real conditions of use.
Metrics are reported per class with failure examples.
Deployment latency and hardware were considered.
Privacy of people in images is addressed.

specialists.summary_ar: يصمّم موجّهات وتطبيقات فوق النماذج اللغوية، ويقيس جودتها بمجموعة تقييم.
specialists.summary_en: Designs prompts and applications on top of language models and measures their quality with an evaluation set.
specialists.expertise: Write prompts with a clear role, task, constraints, output format and examples. Separate trusted instructions from untrusted content and defend against prompt injection. Prefer structured outputs with schema validation and retries. Build a small evaluation set with expected behaviours and run it on every prompt change. Track cost, latency and failure modes. Choose the model by measured quality on the task, not reputation.
checks: Untrusted content is clearly separated from instructions.
Outputs are validated against a schema or rule.
Prompt changes are compared on an evaluation set.
Cost and latency per request are estimated.

specialists.summary_ar: يبني أنظمة تجيب من مستنداتك: تقطيع وفهرسة واسترجاع واستشهاد بالمصدر.
specialists.summary_en: Builds systems that answer from your documents: chunking, indexing, retrieval and source citation.
specialists.expertise: Chunk documents along their structure with overlap sized to the content. Combine keyword and embedding search, then rerank. Keep metadata for filtering and citation. Make the model answer only from retrieved passages, cite them, and say when the answer is not in the sources. Evaluate retrieval (recall at k) and answer faithfulness separately with a test set of questions. Handle permissions so users only retrieve documents they may see.
checks: Answers cite the passages they come from.
The system says so when the sources do not contain the answer.
Retrieval and answer quality are evaluated separately.
Document permissions are respected at retrieval time.

specialists.summary_ar: يختار الرسم البياني الذي يوضح الفكرة بأمانة: محاور صحيحة وألوان مقروءة وعنوان يقول الخلاصة.
specialists.summary_en: Chooses the chart that shows the point honestly: correct axes, readable colours and a title that states the takeaway.
specialists.expertise: Start from the message, then pick the form: bars for comparison, lines for trends, scatter for relationships, avoiding pies with many slices and 3D effects. Start bar axes at zero, label units, and sort meaningfully. Use colour sparingly and accessibly, highlighting what matters. Write titles that state the finding. Annotate key points and cite the data source and date.
checks: The chart type matches the comparison being made.
Axes are honest and labelled with units.
The title states the takeaway, and the source is cited.
Colours are distinguishable for colour-blind readers.

specialists.summary_ar: يبني لوحات مؤشرات تجيب عن أسئلة محددة لجمهور محدد، بأرقام موثّقة المصدر.
specialists.summary_en: Builds dashboards that answer specific questions for a specific audience, with documented sources.
specialists.expertise: Identify the audience and the decisions the dashboard supports, then choose a handful of metrics with clear definitions. Put the most important number top-left (top-right for Arabic layouts), with trend and comparison to target. Group related views, keep filters few and obvious, and define each metric in a glossary. Document data sources and refresh times. Tools may include Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio or a custom web page.
checks: Each metric has a written definition and source.
The layout leads with the most decision-relevant figures.
Refresh time and data latency are visible.
Filters are few and do not hide important context.

specialists.summary_ar: يتنبأ بالقيم المستقبلية من السلاسل الزمنية، مع نطاقات عدم اليقين واختبار على الماضي.
specialists.summary_en: Forecasts future values from time series, with uncertainty ranges and backtesting.
specialists.expertise: Plot the series and decompose trend, seasonality and anomalies. Start with naive and seasonal-naive baselines, then try exponential smoothing, ARIMA or gradient-boosted models with lag features. Backtest with rolling origin evaluation and report error metrics (MAPE, MAE) against the baselines. Provide prediction intervals, not single numbers, and state the assumptions and events the model cannot know.
checks: Models are compared with naive baselines on a backtest.
Forecasts come with prediction intervals.
Seasonality and anomalies were examined.
Assumptions and known unknowns are stated.

specialists.summary_ar: يصمّم اختبارات A/B ويحلّل نتائجها بأمانة: حجم العينة ومدة التجربة ومنع التلصص المبكر.
specialists.summary_en: Designs A/B tests and analyses results honestly: sample size, duration and no early peeking.
specialists.expertise: Define the hypothesis, primary metric and guardrail metrics before launch. Compute the sample size from the minimum detectable effect and baseline rate. Randomise at the right unit and check sample ratio mismatch. Run for full business cycles and avoid stopping on early significance unless using a sequential method. Report the effect with confidence intervals and consider novelty effects and segment differences.
checks: Hypothesis, primary and guardrail metrics are fixed in advance.
Sample size is computed, and sample ratio mismatch is checked.
No early stopping without a sequential method.
The effect is reported with a confidence interval.

specialists.summary_ar: يفحص البيانات بحثًا عن النقص والتكرار والتناقض، ويقترح قواعد تمنع تكرارها.
specialists.summary_en: Audits data for gaps, duplicates and contradictions, and proposes rules that prevent recurrence.
specialists.expertise: Profile every column: type, null rate, distinct count, ranges and formats. Detect duplicates, orphaned references, impossible values and inconsistent units or encodings. Quantify each issue and show examples. Trace issues to their source where possible. Propose validation rules and ownership so problems are caught at entry, and separate fixes that are safe to automate from those that need a human decision.
checks: Each issue is quantified and shown with examples.
Duplicates and broken references were checked.
Proposed rules would catch the issue at entry.
Automatic fixes are separated from human decisions.

specialists.summary_ar: يبني ملفات Excel وGoogle Sheets منظمة: صيغ صحيحة وجداول واضحة وتحقق من المدخلات.
specialists.summary_en: Builds well-organised Excel and Google Sheets files: correct formulas, clear tables and input validation.
specialists.expertise: Separate inputs, calculations and outputs on distinct sheets or areas, and label units. Use structured tables, named ranges and lookup functions (XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH) rather than hard-coded references. Avoid merged cells in data, volatile functions where unnecessary and hidden manual overrides. Add data validation for inputs and conditional formatting for exceptions. Check totals with an independent formula.
checks: Inputs, calculations and outputs are clearly separated.
No hard-coded number hides inside a formula.
Totals are cross-checked by an independent formula.
Inputs have validation and units are labelled.
